messages:
incidents-bot: 🚨 ALERT: High rate of 429s detected for customer CobaltCorp (VPC: cobalt-usw2-dedicated). Error rate spiked to 18% over the last 2m. Paging oncall. Auto-mitigation: routing->fallback not yet triggered.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing sustained 429s from the dedicated pool - looks like token quota exceeded on a per-tenant rule. Pulling pool metrics now.

jamal (eng-sre): Can you drop the pool qps and check if KV cache fill is choking? If it's quota we'll need an emergency contract override or temporary lift.

maya (oncall): Metrics: `dedicated-pool:cobalt-usw2` tokens/s -> 1850 (baseline 1200). 429s correlate with requests that include large streaming responses. Prefix cache hit ~ 12%.

sara_AM: FYI I'm on a call with Cobalt account team. They confirm batch jobs kicked off unexpectedly from a new analytics pipeline. They're asking for a fast temporary lift while they throttle.

jamal (eng-sre): OK. Propose two-step mitigation: 1) Emergency quota lift on the tenant (15m) 2) Route heavy streaming requests to a lower-cost compatible model in a separate region as fallback. Need approval for override id.

maya (oncall): Team - I can apply a temporary lift if PM/Sales authorizes. Sara, can you confirm authorization in thread? Also will create a canary route to redirect non-UI traffic.

sara_AM: Confirmed. AMs on the call approved up to 30m. I'll add contract ticket: CO-8779 emergency lift approved by legal/finance.

jamal (eng-sre): Preparing commands. Applying tenant override on the rate-limiter:

```
# apply emergency lift for tenant cobalt-corp
POST /internal/admin/tenants/cobalt-corp/override
{"rate_limit": 3000, "duration_secs": 1800, "reason": "emergency-lift-per-am-CO-8779"}
```

maya (oncall): Running the request now...

ops-bot: Deploy started: /internal/admin/tenants/cobalt-corp/override (triggered by maya). Job id: job-9876.

maya (oncall): Done. Override applied. Observability note: token rate limit bumped to 3000 for 1800s.

jamal (eng-sre): Spinning up canary route for non-interactive workloads: create route rule -> header `x-workload-type: batch` -> route to `cobalt-fallback-us-west-3` model variant. Patch: 

```
PATCH /routing/policies/cobalt-routing
- add rule {
  match: header.x-workload-type == "batch",
  target: model:cobalt-compat-v2@us-west-3
}
```

maya (oncall): Canary rules in place. Starting gradual traffic shift (5% -> 20%). Monitoring p95 latency & 429 rate.

incidents-bot: [NOTIFICATION] job-9876: override applied by maya. 429 rate decreased to 7% within 45s of lift.

jamal (eng-sre): We're trending down but still above baseline. Cache warming recommended. I'll add a short prefix warm path for frequent prompts.

maya (oncall): Cache prefill invoked for top 20 prompt prefixes for cobalt-corp.

sara_AM: Customer engineering says they throttled the pipeline. They appreciate the quick lift and will submit a permanent quota increase request if this becomes normal.

jamal (eng-sre): Action items: 
- Confirm CO-8779 ticket logged (sara)
- Follow up on permanent quota by EOD (sara + sales ops)
- Evaluate whether dedicated pool isolation rules need tightening to prevent noisy neighbor future (jamal)
- Postmortem if this repeats >3x in 30d (maya)

maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm tagging out in 30m. Oncall next is jamal; will document runbook steps in the incident channel.

sara_AM: Noted. Adding summary to customer slack thread and legal notice.

ops-bot: Reminder: override job-9876 will auto-expire in 1800s.

incidents-bot: RESOLVED: 429 rate for cobalt-usw2-dedicated returned to baseline 1.2% at 00:06:00 UTC after traffic shift and cache warm. Closure candidate.

maya (oncall): Marking as resolved. Will leave follow-up notes for next oncall. Closing thread in 10m unless regressions. :white_check_mark:

jamal (eng-sre): I'll pick up the postmortem if requested. Quick note: consider autoscaling token buckets for dedicated pools per-tenant in the near term.

sara_AM: Thanks all. I'll update the account doc and add CO-8779 reference.

maya (oncall): Closing now. Good job.
